description: This file contains unit tests for various components in the OpenClaw macOS application. It includes tests for protocol buffer encoding/decoding, attributed string manipulation, view metrics, shell command execution, node info serialization, presence reporting, port guardian functionality, file handling and security for a canvas scheme handler, menu UI interactions, and window code helpers.

classes.name: LowCoverageHelperTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple unit tests for various functionalities in the OpenClaw macOS application.

methods.name: any codable helper accessors
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of the custom AnyCodable type, verifying correct conversion to dictionary and foundation types.

methods.name: attributed string strips foreground color
methods.description: Verifies that the strippingForegroundColor() method properly removes foreground color attributes from attributed strings.

methods.name: view metrics reduce width
methods.description: Tests the reduction logic of ViewMetricsTesting.reduceWidth method.

methods.name: shell executor handles empty command
methods.description: Ensures that running an empty shell command results in failure with an error message.

methods.name: shell executor runs command
methods.description: Verifies successful execution and output of a simple shell command.

methods.name: shell executor times out
methods.description: Checks that the shell executor correctly times out when specified.

methods.name: shell executor drains stdout and stderr
methods.description: Ensures that stdout and stderr are fully captured during a script execution.

methods.name: node info codable round trip
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of the NodeInfo struct to verify serializable integrity.

methods.name: presence reporter helpers
methods.description: Tests various helper functions related to presence reporting in the application.

methods.name: port guardian parses listeners and builds reports
methods.description: Verifies parsing listener output and building port reports with expected offenders.

methods.name: port guardian remote mode does not kill docker
methods.description: Ensures certain commands in remote mode are recognized as expected and not flagged as offenders.

methods.name: port guardian local mode still rejects unexpected
methods.description: Tests rejection of unexpected commands in local mode for security.

methods.name: port guardian remote mode report accepts any listener
methods.description: Verifies that in remote mode, any listener is accepted without offenders.

methods.name: canvas scheme handler resolves files and errors
methods.description: Tests path resolution, security, and response correctness for session files via CanvasSchemeHandler.

methods.name: canvas scheme handler blocks symlink escapes
methods.description: Ensures that symlinked paths outside the root are detected and forbidden.

methods.name: menu context card injector inserts and finds index
methods.description: Tests the menu item insertion point logic and width adjustments in a context menu injector.

methods.name: canvas window helper functions
methods.description: Verifies session key sanitization, stored frame persistence, and IP address parsing/recognition functions.
